description: This file defines the Redis cache class within the OpenCart system's library cache namespace. It provides methods to connect to Redis, get, set, and delete cache entries, with support for expiration.

classes.name: Redis
classes.description: A cache class managing Redis connections and operations, including get, set, and delete cache entries with optional expiration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Redis connection with optional expiration time.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value by key, decoding it from JSON.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in the cache with an optional expiration time, encoding it as JSON.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a cached value by key.
